changelog: Refusals on WooCommerce → Restock show as warnings or errors, not as success notices (WCAG 3.3.1): nothing chosen to delete, only an open restock chosen, a request that couldn't be added, and a CSV file that's missing or too big.
The bottom bulk-action selector on the Requests and Restocks lists works without JavaScript. WordPress reads only the top one and relies on its script to copy the bottom choice across.
The delete confirmation's Cancel, and the refusal when nothing can be deleted, return to the page of restocks the manager was on.
The Restocks list reads each item's name once per page and formats dates in one place.
